notes: Capability-vector registry (see .claude/rules/agent-topology.md, Capability Model). No script currently reads this file - it is Controller/Planner-consulted configuration, not a machine-enforced source of truth. Claude-only: this repo's dispatch contract does not support other providers. roleDefaults below intentionally omits `effort`: the single authoritative logical effort per role (light/standard/high/max) lives in agent-topology.md's dispatch-roles block, so it is never restated here where it could drift out of sync.

registry.notes: longctx/synthesis specialist; not a default for any role here, use only when an item's required capability floor explicitly needs longctx or synthesis above what sonnet-5/opus-5 provide
cheapest tier; caps are this session's project-defined judgement, not scored in the source spec

maintenanceRules: IDs are permanent; a retired model is marked deprecated: true, never deleted or reused.
caps changes require a Decision log review (agent-topology.md), not an opinion.
An agent holding a deprecated ID mid-task finishes on it; new assignments do not use it.

requestEvaluator.note: Pre-Controller bootstrap role; not in agent-topology.md's dispatch-roles block because the Controller never dispatches it (see that block's note).

controller.note: Controller is the orchestrating session itself, not a dispatchable subagent file; this is guidance for starting a fresh session, not a live switch on an already-running one. Logical effort baseline is agent-topology.md dispatch-roles.controller.effort (light), not restated here.

planner.escalationReason: genuine architecture/contract ambiguity that raises reasoning >= 8

selection.algorithm: candidates = non-deprecated registry entries whose caps meet every axis of the role's (or item's, if raised) requiredCaps; selected = candidates sorted by costWeight ascending, first; empty candidates -> re-scope the item, never assign an insufficient model.
selection.effortSnap: if the desired logical effort maps to a level in the selected model's effortLevels, use it; else use the next level above; if none above, use the highest supported level and flag effort-ceiling-reached.
selection.effortCaveat: No live numerical effort dial is confirmed exposed by the Agent tool in this runtime (model choice only: sonnet/opus/haiku/fable aliases). Treat effort above as logical/prompted depth within the chosen model until a runtime effort control is verified - see agent-topology.md, Concrete runtime effort.

intakeEvaluator.changeNote: was sonnet-max/max effort for a deliberately thin classification-only bootstrap role - downgraded to the cheapest model meeting its reasoning>=5 floor, consistent with 'Requester is trusted only with cheap, conservative, easily-corrected decisions'.

modelEscalation.when: Controller hits a genuine longctx/synthesis capability ceiling on claude-opus-5 (large multi-tracker synthesis, extensive document research), not for routine reasoning escalation
